style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots and bulk grids, pale sprout-green #E9F0E4 graphic fields and a matte white muslin quilt #F2EEE7 for care scenes, with one solid meadow-green #3E9149 band held across the lower edge of the infographic screens
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, dotted guide lines and blank rounded seal frames, drawn only in #FFFFFF or #3E9149
style.lightingSystem: neutral daylight-balanced studio light around 5500K, soft front-left key with generous fill, low contrast, gentle contact shadows only, no harsh speculars and no coloured gels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium baby-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale sprout-green #E9F0E4, meadow-green lower band #3E9149 and charcoal text #33383D; neutral daylight-balanced lighting around 5500K with a soft front-left key, generous fill and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in one weight family; thin single-line icon style with dotted guides and blank seal frames; clean high-end baby-care photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable soft-pack silhouette and label placement, adult hands only and infants always framed identity-free; generous even margins on every layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cluttered props.
style.presentationRules: the soft pack keeps one identical silhouette, lid position and label placement across the set; sheets read as clean white cloth-like textures; adults are represented by hands only and infants are always framed identity-free
style.surfaceSystem: matte white muslin quilt #F2EEE7, walnut-brown matte counter #8A5A38, warm greige changing-pad surface #B9AFA5 and sage-painted wall #A9C4A4
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in one weight family; every headline and label is a placeholder, no source wording is reproduced
